method: Full-product audit against 30 dimensions, ranked P0–P3, evidence cited. Highest-value feasible findings are implemented this phase, not merely reported.

gaps.evidence: All 600+ pages teach Hindi only; no /learn/<target>/ beyond Hindi; js/learning-paths.js, practice-bank.js, hindi-*.js hard-code Hindi
gaps.action: Language registry + content schema + reusable engines (this phase)

gaps.evidence: No goal-based entry; learner lands on a long hub with no path recommendation
No page answers 'which languages can I learn'; search shows Hindi-only types
gaps.action: Global language hub reading the registry (this phase)

gaps.evidence: Only BROWSER_TTS (speechSynthesis hi-IN); no recorded audio; no provider abstraction
gaps.action: Audio provider abstraction (this phase); recorded audio needs a partner

gaps.evidence: No hear→speak→compare flow; no mic consent flow
gaps.action: Speech architecture; do not fake scores

gaps.evidence: No scenario engine; practice is quiz/typing/worksheet only
Static hosting; no server relay; booking relies on Sheets/forms
gaps.action: Provider abstraction; ship nothing with client-side secrets

gaps.evidence: search-index has Language/Country types but only Devanagari transliteration; no per-script aliases
gaps.action: Extend fuzzy maps per script + type facets

gaps.evidence: My Hindi only (my-progress page); no multi-language progress model
12 tools hard-code Hindi data + Devanagari assumptions
gaps.action: Map tools to reusable categories; remove hard-coding only where evidence shows it limits reuse

gaps.evidence: No child-oriented schema, no heritage pathways
Grammar is prose inside 15 lessons, not structured data
Culture woven into lessons, not structured
158 source-country pages exist but no India-visitor/NRI module structure
16 localized homes; no hreflang; language sitemap exists but no reciprocal pairs
Learn Ops is Hindi-specific; no language/country health board
Registries/schema are new; needs duplicate/route/secret validators
